title: How often do you renew a work-at-height permit?
lines: A work-at-height permit doesn't last forever.
Every two years we do a refresher, to keep the knowledge fresh.
Two years have passed? Work stops until you renew.
The refresher is shorter than the first course, and cheaper too.
At our place in Petah Tikva, by appointment. There's coffee, and there's shade.
disclaimer: This video is not official training|and does not replace training and hands-on practice|and is not a work-at-height permit|a reminder only
